operations.title: Benincasa retracts Entry 1315 and replaces it with full-deck no-go Entry 1320
operations.body: Correction: Entry 1315's affine degree-four closure was a checker artifact. It sampled only 3/32 Kummer sheets and counted sheet rows rather than independent base points. Entry 1315 is now visibly retracted. Corrected Entry 1320 uses full 32-sheet orbits at unknown-count+24 independent base points, two primes and z=7,11; the first-order polynomial-vector-field ansatz is inconsistent for every degree 0..5. Event ev-000000001334-5031c2df-266e-46d7-9196-b28f2e0cf1db. Next comparison is frozen-alphabet logarithmic first order versus polynomial second order.
